get_dataset_config_info: get the config info and splits for a Hugging Face dataset by path and config name
get_dataset_config_names: list all available config names for a Hugging Face dataset by its path
get_dataset_default_config_name: get the default config name for a Hugging Face dataset by its path
get_dataset_infos: get all dataset infos including configs and splits for a Hugging Face dataset
get_dataset_split_names: get the split names for a specific config of a Hugging Face dataset
